verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents some first-party export paths: support articles on downloading Extended and Summary cap table reports, and downloadable PDFs of round-modeling analysis. There is no evidence of a complete, structured export of all company data in open formats, and the migration and spreadsheet-import material describes moving data in, not out. Missing for 10: a documented full-account data export, confirmation of open machine-readable formats (CSV/JSON/XLSX) for the cap table reports, export of documents, certificates and transaction history, an API or bulk export for leaving, and independent corroboration of exit portability.
